# Alico to Participate at Oppenheimer 11th Annual Emerging Growth Conference


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_d48dcc1f3275389050f3a74fc3712b3d/alicoinc/news/2026-01-22_Alico_to_Participate_at_Oppenheimer_11th_Annual_1452.pdf) January 22, 2026


FORT MYERS, Fla., Jan. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alico, Inc. (“Alico” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: ALCO) today announced that John Kiernan, the Company’s President and Chief Executive Officer, will host one-on-one meetings with investors at Oppenheimer 11th Annual Emerging Growth Conference, taking place virtually on February 3-4, 2026.


**About Alico**


Alico, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALCO) is a Florida-based agribusiness and land management company with over 125 years of experience. Following its strategic transformation in 2025, Alico operates as a diversified land company with approximately 49,537 acres across 8 Florida counties as of September 30, 2025. The Company focuses on strategic land development opportunities and diversified agricultural operations, leveraging its extensive land portfolio to create long-term shareholder value while maintaining its commitment to responsible land stewardship and conservation.
